name: Synthetic Destiny
oracle_text: Exile all creatures you control. At the beginning of the next end step, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal that many creature cards, put all creature cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your library.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of the next end step, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal that many creature cards, put all creature cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your library.

needs.what: a reveal-until walk that stops after N matching cards (N a value, here the number of creatures exiled by the spell's first sentence, carried into a delayed end-step trigger), moves every match to the destination, and shuffles the rest into the library instead of bottoming them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: reveal_until stops at the first match and moves only that one card, has no amount, and only bottoms the rest in random order (rest_to_bottom) rather than shuffling; there is also no value that reads how many objects an earlier exile in the same spell moved for use inside a delayed_trigger
